method_findings: (1) 17/389 cold starts (4.4%) have first valid coolant sample later than 10 s (max 74 s); none within 1 C of a cut; lowering their start by 1/2/3/5/10 C reassigns 0/0/1/2/5 drives: insensitive. Tie rule matters more: 5 starts =30 and 11 =48 go up; 46 starts within 1 C of a cut; cuts 30.5/48.5 would give 136/132/121.

(2) Not a season proxy (Spearman start-month 0.05; month mix similar). Trip length: median km 2.4/4.1/2.4, under 5 km 0.69/0.55/0.71. Start hour median 11/16/14, before 10:00 0.31/0.12/0.20 (soak-time proxy). Right-censored drives coolant 80: 0.70/0.45/0.53; oil 70: 0.78/0.62/0.70.

(3) Stratum 2 vs 3 F differ by 0.016: the contrast is a stratum-1-versus-rest pattern, not a gradient; oil c21 interval includes 0. D about 0 must not be read as 'censoring is harmless': within-stratum independence is still assumed (upper bounds 0.55-0.87). Stratum 3 coolant support is thin (17 drives, 15 days).
